name: GXO Logistics Distribution Center - Arlington TX

fieldNotes.truckGate: Chain-link fence encloses the north dock yard; a sliding/cantilever gate spans the truck drive entrance off the internal park road (visible in 2026-03 Street View).
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gated entry but no guard booth visible at the gate - kiosk/app check-in implied.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: North dock face is a continuous numbered dock band; doors 22-37+ visible in Street View, full bank estimated ~40 across the GXO-occupied section.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Trailers parked in marked rows in the fenced north yard, separate from active dock apron.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved dock apron inside the fence provides ample truck staging before docks.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Single multi-tenant industrial building; GXO occupies the dock-served portion.
